subject: U-CHAIN r3 complete: all six items fixed, 28/28 mutants RED, harness replays green from a clean clone
body: Fixed all six round-3 items on ravidsrk/u-chain (fix 5bd2eb07, evidence 14575aba, BASE re-merge 0213c734): G-1 adds the BOT-4 freshness obligation to resume alternative 1 (a REMOTE default is refreshed via git fetch immediately before the ancestry check with the resolved SHA recorded, and a ref whose freshness cannot be established leaves the promotion UNPROVEN and parked, never landed; the offline LOCAL-ref branch is kept and the ancestry subject is pinned to leg N's own BASE tip); G-2 derives the harness baseline from ed51fe11's blob and hash-checks it against the reviewer's recorded 1bacd1fe...; G-3 makes a kill require an ASSERTION failure from the covering test, with stillborn runs and red controls failing the harness; G-4/G-5/G-6 bind each numbered resume alternative inside its own segment, the carry table's full field set plus the gate record's identity/state and the missing-vs-empty rule, and reconstruction ancestry plus the mirror's written refs and the integrity-inventory hash. All twelve of round 2's executed survivors now die, each on the assertion written for it (survivor-to-assertion table in docs/reports/U-CHAIN/round-3-answers.md); run_mutants-r3.py reports 31 cases - 28 RED, 3 neutral reflows GREEN, 0 survivors, 0 stillborn, both controls GREEN - and both batteries run to completion from a fresh git clone with no base-policy.md, while the two round-2 trust probes now drive the unmodified committed harness to exit 1. Nothing is left of the six items: suite 1707 tests OK exit 0, validate.py exit 0, negative control RED at the reverted policy and GREEN restored, policy 94/160 lines, worktree clean, BASE (9ae38a79) merged and re-verified; no assertion was weakened and no probe deleted, and no PR action was taken per the spec's non-goals.
